'''Ranger Rubinah Sunsworn''' is a [[high elf]] [[hunter trainer]] located in [[Brinthilien]] in the [[Thalassian Highlands]].

:'''The subject of this section was removed from the game in [[patch 1.17.1]].'''

==Quotes==
;Gossip
The Farstriders were a proud group of rangers. With the downfall of our homeland, most of them, too, have passed away. Still, their legacy will live on through us.

==Speculation==
She may be related to [[Astalor Sunsworn]], [[Andanil Sunsworn]] and [[Priestess Maelah Sunsworn]].
